chunks: And when you do not bring a (Qur'anic) verse to them, they say: "Why don't you make one up?" Say: "I follow only what my Lord reveals to me." These (revels) are an evident proof from your Lord, and a guidance and grace for those who believe.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Why don't you make one up?' in Surah Al-A'raf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's (SAWW) absolute reliance on wahy (revelation) rather than personal agency, refuting the Quraysh's demand for arbitrary signs by affirming the Qur'an as the enduring miracle. It highlights the tripartite function of the scripture as basa'ir (intellectual insights), hudan (guidance), and rahmah (mercy), specifically tailored for the community of believers who possess both faith and reason.
